source_text: 唐朝始于618年,终于907年,是中国历史上最灿烂的时期。经过近三百年的发展,唐代中国成为世 界上最繁荣的强国，其首都长安是当时世界上最大的都市。这一时期，经济发达、商业繁荣、社会秩序稳 定，甚至边境也对外开放。随着城市化和财富的增加，艺术和文学也繁荣起来。李白和杜甫是以作品简洁 自然而著称的诗人。他们的诗歌打动了学者和普通人的心。即使在今天，他们的许多诗歌仍广为儿童及 成人阅读背诵
reference_translation: The Tang Dynasty, which lasted from 618 to 907, was the most glorious period in Chinese history. After nearly three centuries of development, Tang China emerged as the most prosperous and powerful country in the world, with its capital, Chang'an, being the largest metropolis at that time. During this era, the economy was well-developed, commerce thrived, social order remained stable, and even the borders were open to the outside world. Along with urbanization and the growth of wealth, art and literature also flourished. Li Bai and Du Fu were poets renowned for their simple and natural works. Their poems touched the hearts of both scholars and ordinary people. Even today, many of their poems are still widely read and recited by children and adults.
